text: 据深圳商报，7月，A股市场显著调整，各私募策略7月以来平均回报全部收负。量化多头平均下跌16.94%，正收益占比仅4.03%，几乎是全军覆没；主观多头平均下跌7.91%，虽有约三成产品仍录得正收益，却挡不住整体净值下台阶。与之形成对照的是，在管理规模50亿以上、且7月以来平均回报仍为正的管理人名单里，核心策略以主观多头、债券型与管理期货为主——量化多头一名未入。 好买基金研究中心统计显示，截至7月31日，私募各策略7月以来平均回报由高到低(跌幅由小到大)大致为：债券型-0.53%、管理期货-1.27%、套利型-2.95%、市场中性-3.33%、宏观策略-
text_en: According to Shenzhen Business Daily, A-shares saw significant adjustments in July, with average returns across all private fund strategies turning negative since July. Quantitative long strategies fell 16.94% on average, with only 4.03% posting positive returns—nearly a total wipeout; discretionary long strategies fell 7.91% on average, and though about 30% of products still logged positive returns, overall net values slid. In contrast, among managers with over 5 billion yuan in AUM and still positive average returns since July, core strategies are mainly discretionary long, bond, and managed futures—no quantitative long managers made the list. Howbuy Fund Research Center data shows that as of July 31, average returns by strategy since July, from high to low (smallest to largest decline), are roughly: bond -0.53%, managed futures -1.27%, arbitrage -2.95%, market neutral -3.33%, macro strategy -
